TodoEvidence.Title: Setup prompt for obtaining, installing, and configuring MCP Server by a frontier agent
Description: Deliver a reusable frontier-agent setup prompt (and supporting checklist) that obtains, installs, and configures MCP Server so a fresh agent can reach a verified working host without operator tribal knowledge.

The prompt MUST interactively gather environment specifics before acting: agents in use, development process (BDPv4 or user-owned process), storage backend (MSSQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite), and service installation target (Windows Service, systemd, or other).

The prompt MUST give concrete handling guidance for each intake scenario (and common combinations), not only ask questions: what to install, which plugin/identity path, how to wire storage, how to register the service, verify, and what to do on failure.

Session log is NOT available during setup. After intake, the agent MUST write (1) a setup choices manifest capturing answers and selected playbook IDs, and (2) an implementation plan derived from those choices, before performing obtain/install/configure. Later steps and verify read that manifest/plan, not a session log.
Scope: Windows lab host (PAYTON-LEGION2 pattern) first as a reference path; branch install/configure steps from the gathered answers. Document extension points for other hosts.
Out of scope for v1: production multi-tenant deploy, public publishing of add-profile/operator profile, and process-drift enforcement (MCP-PROCESS-001).
TechnicalDetails: Artifact target: docs prompt under mcpserver (or plugin docs) plus a copy-paste agent prompt block; prefer PowerShell-only steps where the host is Windows; note shell equivalents when target is systemd/other.
Interactive intake (required before obtain/install): (1) agents used; (2) process: BDPv4 vs custom; (3) storage: MSSQL | PostgreSQL | SQLite; (4) service target: Windows Service | systemd | other.

Scenario playbooks: per-agent (plugin/identity/skill/invoke); per-process (BDPv4 vs custom); per-storage (config/prereqs/bootstrap/smoke); per-service-target (install/start/stop/logs/health). Conflicts refuse or redirect with remediation.

Post-intake artifacts (required, no session log): setup-choices.manifest (YAML or JSON) with answers, playbook IDs, timestamp, host notes; setup-implementation.plan with ordered steps, branched commands, verify criteria, and stop conditions. Path convention documented in the prompt (e.g. under workspace docs/setup/ or operator-chosen path).
Obtain/install/configure/verify MUST load the manifest and follow the plan; verify asserts manifest fields match the live host and that plan steps were completed.
Invoke path after install: host-matched plugin via lib/repl-invoke.ps1 / skills/*/scripts/invoke.ps1; identity from manifest. Do not default to raw :7147 REST or broken box connectors.
Success = smoke type:result for sessionlog bootstrap, todo query, memory list/get against chosen storage/service, plus confirmation that verify matched the written manifest/plan.
